city: Sheikh Zayed Road and Deira, Dubai
summary: Crossroads has strong Google reviews, two branches, financing options and a booking form. The page hides that form and has errors that weaken a clinic selling implants.

findings.problem: Book An Appointment is buried inside the Contact Us dropdown instead of being a visible header button. Hero buttons use mixed labels such as For Appointment, Visit Us twice and about us in lowercase.
findings.cost: A patient ready to book has to hunt for the form, and many will not.
findings.fix: One clear Book Now button in the header and hero, on every page.

findings.problem: Menu links for Root Canal Specialist, Implantologist, Gallery and Contact Us go to #, and the Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook icons link to #.
findings.cost: Dead links lose visitors and remove your best proof, since social pages show real patients.
findings.fix: Working links everywhere and a real gallery page.

findings.problem: Typos and stray text: Impantologist, a Slide 1 label, stray 18 text in the gallery, and weekday opening hours missing. The Smile Transformations gallery shows no before and after images.
findings.cost: For a clinic selling implants, a typo in the title of the main specialist weakens trust, and a missing gallery hides your results.
findings.fix: A proofread build with full opening hours and captioned results.

findings.problem: The booking form has no doctor preference and a fixed time list that ignores each branch's different Sunday hours. There are no starting prices.
findings.cost: Patients who cannot choose a doctor or see a price drop out or book elsewhere.
findings.fix: A branch aware booking form and starting prices for top treatments.

redesign: A booking first header and hero, with branch, doctor, treatment and time in one short form.
A real before and after gallery and your Google reviews beside every booking button.
A page per treatment and per doctor, written to rank for searches like dental implants Dubai.
